tagline: 柯尼卡旁轴相机，1993 年发布
description: 柯尼卡于1993年推出的旁轴相机。配备Hexar 35mm f2; six groups, seven elements; minimum aperture f22; built-in lens hood。快门速度Electromagnetic 30secs - 1/250。使用Motor (and rewind)。感光度EV 0-16 at ISO 100 (centre) EV3-18 (spot)。infrared active - 290 steps。

specs.镜头: Hexar 35mm f2; six groups, seven elements; minimum aperture f22; built-in lens hood
specs.曝光测光: Programmed AE, aperture priority, metered manual
specs.取景器: Reverse Galilean with bright lines, automatic parallax and angle of field correction
specs.自拍: Electronic (approx 10 seconds; no thread for a cable release)
specs.英文简介: The Konica Hexar, first released in 1993, is a fixed-lens, autofocus camera from Konica with a 35mm f2 lens, rather expensive when new.
